title: Buddy Petit as first to run diminished chords on trumpet
summary: Vincent says Buddy Petit was the first trumpeter he heard using such chords and variations, and was a good musician who drank wine.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: I'm going to ask you, just a moment. Turn it on. Come on in. I'm going to ask you when the trumpet players started running diminished chords and stuff.

Say, when did the trumpet players start running diminished chords and things? Well, see, Buddy, you know, Buddy Petee, he's the person I heard, you know. Buddy used to tell us where you're going to make it, you know. And after a while, the other fellas, I and all of them, they picked it up, you see. Buddy's the first one, though. Buddy Petee was the person I heard and made it. And the person who made the variation in high society, too, on the corner. Buddy Petee was, you know.
How does that variation go? You know, that.
Were the clarinet players making it first?

Yeah, the clarinet players, they're supposed to make it. But Buddy just took it away from me and make it himself, you see. Then the other clarinet players begin to learn. Then they start to make it, you know.
Well, did Buddy know chords and theory? Ask him.

Did Buddy know much about chords and theory? Yeah. I know. Buddy didn't know more than what we taught, you know. It's all that wine used to keep Buddy like that, didn't it? To drink so hard, you know. Buddy was a good musician. Yeah.
